summary: Create a unique temporary directory by appending random characters directly to the supplied prefix.

semantics.return_value: created directory path as string/Buffer according to encoding
semantics.name_generation: appends six random characters directly to prefix
semantics.mutation: creates directory atomically enough to avoid collisions

caveats: Path.GetTempPath/GetRandomFileName do not preserve prefix placement or Node return conventions.
To create inside a directory, the source prefix must itself include the trailing separator.

tests.name: prefix is preserved
tests.expected_behavior: creates a unique directory whose returned path begins with the exact prefix

tests.name: no implicit separator
tests.expected_behavior: random suffix is appended directly to '/tmp/j2cs'; helper must not silently insert a path separator
